blocks.text: Stunning Anime-Inspired Nissan GTR Wrap: Symphogear Edition

blocks.alt: This Nissan GTR features a striking Symphogear-themed partial wrap with Hibiki Tachibana

blocks.html:
This Nissan GTR sports a striking Symphogear-themed wrap, featuring Hibiki Tachibana in bold, vibrant detail. With high-energy colors and sleek graphics, it’s a perfect fusion of anime and automotive artistry. Unveiled at Anime North, it turned heads and captivated fans, making it a true standout on the streets and at events!
